name: wall-press-straight-leg-extension
instructions:
1. Setup in a supine position with your hips flexed, legs straight, and arms pressing overhead into a wall.
2. Lower one leg while you exhale.
3. Return back to the starting position and repeat on the opposite side.
4. Repeat for the desired number of total repetitions.
